title: The Swiss Franc: Why the World’s Safe-Haven Currency Could Become Even More Important
summary: gold is not the only asset investors turn to when confidence in the global financial system begins to weaken. Among the world's currencies, one stands out for its remarkable resilience, monetary credibility, and historical ability to preserve purchasing power: the Swiss franc (CHF).
